Thanks again for the quick intro call yesterday. HelioCore is excited to see Redwood in a short exec-level demo — the CIO (Priya Rao) and the VP of Engineering want to attend if we can secure a short, focused window.

Our ideal days next week are Tue/Wed between 11:00–16:00 ET; Priya and I can be flexible within that chunk. If it helps, we can also do a rolling plan — short shadow first, then the exec window within the same block.
